facebook.caption: POV: you wandered off Võ Thị Sáu street and found this. Dinh Bà Thủy Long Thánh Mẫu is one of Phu Quoc's most atmospheric temples, rated 4.5 stars by 303 visitors. Incense smoke, dragon carvings, total quiet. Two minutes from the busy strip and it feels like a different world. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
